text:
Devon Toews spent years as the partner people forgot about next to Cale Makar, and this season Yahoo Sports is writing that he is reminding the league there is more to Colorado's defense than Makar. He already has 15 points in 17 games, after 24 in 68 last season, and he looked frustrated after this week's overtime loss (Heavy.com, NDTV Sports both ran his short postgame answers).

We like the player and doubt the pace. The Avalanche control about 59% of the 5v5 chances with him on, eight points better than without him, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting to the slot and setting up shots at rates near the top of the league among defensemen last season. But Colorado has scored 7.0 more goals than its chances deserve with Toews on the ice, and he is shooting 15% after years far below that. Evolving-Hockey adds the usual caveat: he plays with some of the best teammates in the sport. Our projection lands near 45 points for the season, which would still be a fine bounce back. The scoring rate halves from here; the play driving should not.
headline: Toews steps out of Makar's shadow, for now
